gate_locations_note: McClintock and Watt use the supplied field survey. Other gate pins approximate the street entrance stated by USC Transportation; confirm their position on site. A parking entrance is not a campus gate.

The gate on W 36th Pl, pinned by the team (2026-11-17); about 22 m from Vermont Ave, so a closed-gate area (12 m) never closes Vermont.

Pinned by the team (2026-11-23), on the driveway in from Jefferson Blvd; the old pin was an intersection guess too close to the structure. The pin is about 12.5 m from Jefferson Blvd, so the closed-gate area sits 10 m south of it, inside campus, and never closes Jefferson.

parking_source: Supplied data/surveyed.json (vehicle entrances and pedestrian exits); gate eligibility from USC Transportation. No occupancy feed.
campus_via_note: campus_via: the points a car passes between the gate and the structure entrance. Ids are surveyed points; [lat, lon] pairs are road corners from OpenStreetMap geometry (West 34th Street at McClintock Avenue, checked 2026-11-24), on the team's route Royal -> 34th St -> McClintock -> Downey Way. Royal Street Entrance is not a way in to Lot 2 or Downey: getting from it to 34th St means driving through the Royal structure (team, 2026-11-24). It stays a way in to the Royal structure itself. Watt Way legs are not mapped yet: the page says so instead of drawing a straight line across campus.
text2park_codes_source: Location codes from the Text2Park signs, listed by the team 2026-11-24. Each opens its own rate plan on https://usc.park.tez.io/location/<code>; a made-up code shows Location not found. GRND (Grand Ave) and 37ST (37th Street) are valid but not in Doorstep yet. FLWR (Flower Street) added the same way, 2026-11-24.

rates_source.name: USC Transportation, Hourly and All Day Parking Availability FY27
rates_source.note: Hourly: up to 4 hours unless noted; 5+ hours are charged the $20 daily rate (shown as the daily max). Text2Park adds a one-time $0.50 fee; pay stations have none. Space-available; event and game-day rates differ (staff post those).

campus_roads_note: Campus roads (team, 2026-11-19): the Royal Street, McClintock, Downey Way and Watt Way entrances connect by car on campus roads (e.g. Royal -> 34th St -> McClintock -> Downey Way -> Watt Way), so a structure reached from one can be reached from the others (Royal and Downey structures, Lot 2). The Jefferson Blvd. and McCarthy Way entrances do NOT connect to the rest of campus by car: they serve only the Jefferson and McCarthy structures. Structures entered straight from a public street (Figueroa, Flower, Shrine) use their own entrance; getting between those means leaving campus, which the driving route already handles.
